proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item family
proposed_widenings.justification: types.ts has no MagicItemRecord. UnitRecord is SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — magic_item is not representable at all. The TAXONOMY lists magic_item_root as a v4 source atom but the surface type system never gained the corresponding record shape.

proposed_widenings.name: create_object mechanics family with persistent object HP/AC profile
proposed_widenings.justification: The Instant Fortress's primary effect is conjuring a physical structure with its own AC, HP, damage immunities, and resistances. No existing spell or class-feature mechanics family encodes 'create a persistent destructible object with typed combat statistics'. The create_object effect atom exists in v4 but there is no surface family that wraps it with object-stat fields (ac, hp, immunities, resistances).
proposed_widenings.evidence: The roof, the door, and the walls each have AC 20; HP 100; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage except that which is dealt by siege equipment; and Resistance to all other damage.

proposed_widenings.name: attunement surface field
proposed_widenings.justification: The item requires attunement, which the surface has no way to record. The v4 attunement_slot resource atom exists, but no surface record type exposes an attunement field.

proposed_widenings.name: bidirectional_transform activation (grow/shrink)
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has two command-word activations: one grows the statuette into a tower, and one shrinks it back (conditional on the tower being empty). No existing family models a reversible object-transform with a precondition on reversal.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form, which works only if the tower is empty.

proposed_widenings.name: force_move (area displacement on object creation)
proposed_widenings.justification: Creatures in the area where the tower appears are pushed to adjacent unoccupied spaces. This is a force_move effect triggered by object instantiation, not by an attack roll or save gate. force_move exists in v4 taxonomy but no surface encoding reaches it from a create_object event.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature in the area where the tower appears is pushed to an unoccupied space outside but next to the tower.

proposed_widenings.name: Bonus Action door-control sub-activation
proposed_widenings.justification: The door opens and closes via a separate Bonus Action command — a second distinct activation on the same item that modifies a property of the created object. No surface mechanic covers sub-activations on created objects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The door opens only at your command, which you can issue as a Bonus Action.

notes: The blocking issue is structural: types.ts defines UnitRecord as SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — there is no MagicItemRecord. No JSON that the tracer could accept exists for this unit. Even if the record type were added, a new mechanics family would be needed to encode (a) create_object with object-level HP/AC/immunity/resistance, (b) bidirectional reversible transform, (c) area force-displacement on instantiation, and (d) attunement. The Wish-based repair clause is also not encodable but is a secondary gap.
